mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies at Verona Community Park with a temperature of 75 degrees and an air quality index of 52, which is in the moderate range.
City Hall is excited to host an I Voted sticker contest for K through 12 students. Designs must be original, and the submission deadline is July 22 at 4 PM, with public voting starting July 28.
There is plenty to do in Verona, including live music today at Bailey's Run and at Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, you can head over to Insight Wellness for a yoga session.
In a notable incident from July 13, officers responded to a call where a driver had become stuck on a large rock; the 36-year-old driver was subsequently arrested for an O-W-I.
Today you can enjoy the OREO Cookie Overload flavor at Culver's. The store is currently closed but will open at 10 AM, and tomorrow you can look forward to the Snickers Swirl.
